ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and remove the no-show strike; note that the driver tapped "I'm Here" while ~1.36 km from the pickup point — advise Ryde ops to coach the driver on correct arrival-tap usage before considering account review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he pressed I'm Here and waited at the pickup is contradicted by the GPS trace: from 22:37:00 to 22:41:50 he was stationary at ~1.44495, 103.78739, about 1.00 km from the pickup point (1.436, 103.7865) and far outside the 200 m arrival radius. System records override the driver statement, so NS-1 (ii) fails and the $6.61 fee is not validly chargeable.
